TMDB API key on this device

Enter your 32-character TMDB API key (v3). Kept privately on this device for the selected account and profile; never synchronised. Leave blank to remove the local key and use an available account or app key. Requires TMDB to be enabled.
Automatically select full subtitles using the saved preference or app language. Explicit None and title choices are respected. Off restores the existing forced-subtitle policy.
Choose the displayed source order. Preferred tags rank first; ties keep addon order. Existing autoplay quality and provider safeguards still apply.
Filter and rank video sources before selection. Required and excluded tags are hard rules; preferred tags rank matching sources first. Zero limits are unlimited. Live TV is unchanged.
Hide the modern or Dynamic sidebar icon pill while navigation is closed. Requires sidebar navigation. Left/Back and the pointer edge still reveal navigation.
Lets the other profiles on this account see this profile's latest movie or episode in their Family Watching row. Nothing is copied to them. Off by default. Ignored for PIN-locked and child profiles.
Maximum matching video sources after filtering and sorting. Zero keeps all matching sources.
Maximum results for each known quality after filtering and sorting. Zero is unlimited. Unknown quality has its own group quota.
Maximum results for each known resolution after filtering and sorting. Zero is unlimited. Unknown resolution has its own group quota.
Minimum known source size in decimal GB. Zero disables the minimum. Sources with unknown sizes remain eligible.
Muted IMDb trailer previews in focused post-play cards. Uses a separate software player; never replaces the main video. Android only, unavailable on low-memory devices. Off by default.
Only allow these release groups, separated by commas. Empty allows any group. Matching is case-insensitive and exact.
Playback percentage before movie recommendations appear. Zero retains the existing credits policy.
Requires Play next episode automatically. Ask for confirmation after this many consecutive episodes before starting another. Zero disables the prompt.
Show movie recommendations near the end of playback. Requires available recommendations from enabled TMDB or Trakt services. Episode autoplay is configured separately.

Shows a Home row with what the other profiles on this account watched most recently. Only profiles that share their watching activity appear; PIN-locked and child profiles never do, and the row is hidden on a child profile. Selecting a card opens the title under this profile. Off by default.
Turn off Automatically load full subtitles to use the forced-only subtitle policy. Explicit None and saved title choices are always respected.
Wait before loading a muted post-play trailer. Focus changes, closing the panel and backgrounding cancel the preview. The poster stays visible on failure.
Wait before starting the automatic trailer after the detail page settles. Stored in tenths of a second.

Changes Family Watching card size and presentation: Card feed, Large landscape, Portrait stories, Presence strip, Poster first or Classic square. The original Friends row also retains its style preference.

Changes the tabs inside streaming collections: Chips, Dropdown, Centre bar, Pages or Top menu. Open a collection containing multiple catalogues to see the selected style. This does not change the main navigation tabs.
Uses a floating icon sidebar in Modern Home. Turn it off for a docked side drawer. Default Home keeps its docked menu and Dynamic Home keeps its Apple TV sidebar.
